entries.name: canvas_item_set_copy_to_backbuffer
entries.owner: CG1: carried on the opt-in render-stream/10 (results/p3/cg1.md); a /8 stream does not carry it
entries.notes: Not carried on /8 or earlier (the gate 6 text said hooked: it never was). Since P3-ST hint_screen_texture shaders are ok on the wire and every receiver mirrors GLES3's automatic back-buffer copies (fixtures/gate55-screen, run-gate55.sh g55s). Since CG1 the opt-in render-stream/10 carries the setter as the item key `copy_to_backbuffer` and the native receiver and the web export re-issue it; since CG3 GSW composites it (delivery.canvas_group_state_10, g8cg). entries.name: render-stream/9 `block` variant: the game's own BC/ETC2/ASTC bytes uploaded as blocks (GRC_TEXTURE_DELIVERY=passthrough)
entries.notes: Equal to a fixture sampling the same .ctex on the same GPU (0 px). The receiver picks by D3: first of its texture_encodings the entry lists, block only when its format family is in gpu_formats, decoded last.

entries.name: render-stream/9 `uastc` variant: KTX2 UASTC LDR 4x4 + zstd transcoded by the receiver to its GPU's block format (GRC_TEXTURE_DELIVERY=basis-uastc)
entries.notes: Lossy tiers are judged against their own oracle (Image.load_ktx_from_buffer of the same payload), never the source: uploaded blocks equal the oracle bit for bit (BC7 on this GPU); the quality band is recorded (quality-band). A transcode the loader refuses (delivery-transcode-failed) falls back to the decoded variant (G8kf: delivery-fallback, sabotage corrupt-ktx2); a prepared cache warms uastc entries (prepare-uastc-warm); a decoded hash that is still being computed arrives as delivery-pending (opt-in GRC_TEXTURE_PENDING=publish) and is recovered.
